content.what_it_is: Fixed-form Fortran utility (unnamed main program) in the Monai Valley spherical benchmark work directory. Reads an 892x244 depth grid from depth_coarse.dat with list-directed input (L3-7), multiplies every value by 100.0 (L9-13, m to cm 'blowup' consistent with the spherical runs' cm convention), and writes to depth_blowup.txt with format 1000f12.3 (L15-19). Structurally identical to sph_conical_island/input/blowup_depth.f but with different dimensions and input filename.
entities: unnamed main program (end @L22); parameter(m=892,n=244) @L1; real depth(m,n) @L2; statement label 100 format(1000f12.3) @L19; implicit loop indices i,j
unresolved: Fixed 892x244 dimensions must match depth_coarse.dat, unverifiable here; the *100.0 factor is presumably m-to-cm for the spherical cm convention but unstated; no IMPLICIT NONE and no program name.
